title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: provide first-class RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and updated quickstarts to help engineers onboard agents that combine retrieval + tool calling. This PR adds curated templates, runnable examples (Python/TS), docs site navigation and quickstart pages, and a small compat shim for the SDK to support agent tool schemas. Summary of changes: add 4 RAG agent templates (faq-bot, support-assistant, sales-playbook, code-exec), add tool-calling examples and scaffolding for python and typescript quickstarts, update docs site sidebar and quickstart pages, include unit tests and e2e example harness, and add README/CHANGELOG entries. Checklist: - [x] Templates added and linted - [x] Examples run locally with redwood SDK v0.9.x - [x] Docs updated and staged build passes - [x] Tests for example harness added - [x] Reviewed for security (no secret keys in examples) Notes: kept templates intentionally minimal, referenced ENG-1245 for product acceptance criteria, and added guidance for pinning model variants and caching recommendations.
